def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    threshold = case["utility_threshold"]
    # Build lookup
    node_map = {node["id"]: node for node in nodes}
    # Build children adjacency
    children = {}
    for node in nodes:
        pid = node["parent"]
        if pid is not None:
            children.setdefault(pid, []).append(node["id"])
    # Sort children lists
    for pid in children:
        children[pid].sort()
    # Find root
    root_id = None
    for node in nodes:
        if node["parent"] is None:
            root_id = node["id"]
            break
    visit_order = []
    retained = []
    def dfs(node_id):
        node = node_map[node_id]
        retain = (not node["removable"]) or (node["utility"] >= threshold)
        visit_order.append(node_id)
        if retain:
            retained.append(node_id)
            for child_id in children.get(node_id, []):
                dfs(child_id)
    dfs(root_id)
    return {"retained_node_ids": retained, "visit_order": visit_order}
